title: torch_vn_algebra: block-diagonal operators, symmetry sectors and quantum channels in PyTorch
description:
torch_vn_algebra is a Python library for batched computation with block-diagonal matrices in symmetry sectors, the finite-dimensional Type I von Neumann algebras (direct sums of matrix algebras), in PyTorch on CPU and GPU. It provides random operators with prescribed spectra and Haar-random unitaries, density matrices and entropies, quantum channels (Kraus, Choi, Stinespring) within and between sectors, tensor products with charge fusion and partial traces, Schrödinger and Lindblad dynamics, spin chains in U(1), momentum and SU(2) sectors with Lanczos and Krylov solvers, the numerical Wedderburn decomposition and commutant of the algebra generated by matrices or by a group representation, inclusions of algebras with conditional expectations and Jones indices, Jordan algebras, Petz and sandwiched Rényi divergences, and constrained batched optimisation, all differentiable with autograd. Self-contained lecture notes with complete proofs and a tested tutorial are included in seven languages.

Companion paper: arXiv:2606.15882. Documentation: https://andre-a-no.github.io/von_neumann_type_i/
